display_name: National Insurance Law Schedule A1 Part D (a woman's age by month of birth), s 72 (the months the child allowance is paid) and s 335 (the branches in which a person pays contributions), with the dispositions of ss 65 and 67A

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents; work order row IL-07's GAPS.md

language.note: English identifiers (@lang en). Hebrew is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/srcquote.py from line N of the deposited source, and in short runs checked by tools/hebcheck.py to occur verbatim in it.

source.authority: aid: unofficial Hebrew Wikisource consolidation, as amended at retrieval

scope: Encoded: Schedule A1 Part D (the age, in months, fixed for a woman by her month of birth, and the day she reaches it); s 72(a)-(c) (whether the child allowance is paid for a month, from May 2015); s 335(a)-(j) (the branches in which contributions are payable, from the statuses it reads, for contribution periods from January 2026). Inert: s 67A, which does not exist in the deposited text (the old s 67A is the present s 108, repealed). Out of scope: s 65, encoded in full by row IL-06; Schedule A1 Parts A, B, C and E; the statuses s 335 reads (insured under Chapters 5, 6, 8, 9 and 11 and for long-term care, s 158(1), s 238, controlling shareholder), which are inputs; ss 66-68 (row IL-06).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run (one session, without sub-agents, as briefed). Every expected value in the tests was worked by hand from the text, by the same session that wrote the rules.

self_check.result: 6 modules, 0 errors, 59 assertions satisfied (2 of them #ASSERT REFUSED), 0 failed, 0 refused

forks.N1: s 72(a) 'עד 15 בחודש': up to and including the 15th.
forks.N2: s 72(c) reaches only a child for whom an allowance had been paid; otherwise (a) ends payment with the month of death.
forks.N3: s 335(a) and (i) impose one maternity branch.
forks.N4: Part D: the day a woman reaches the age is her birthday that many months on, clamped to a shorter month's last day (as row IL-05's F19).
